newsitem.title: JAPAN: Renault Japan sales hit annual record.
newsitem.headline: Renault Japan sales hit annual record.

text.p: Japanese sales of cars made by Renault SA have already hit an annual record with a month still to go, France Motors Co Ltd said on Thursday.
Sales for the year were 2,494 cars as of December 6, surpassing the previous annual record of 2,481 in calendar 1990.
France Motors, a wholly owned unit of foreign car dealer Yanase & Co Ltd, began importing and distributing Renault cars in October 1994.
Of the total, sales of the Renault Twingo minicar reached 1,375, a France Motors spokesman said.
France Motors has set a target of 2,700 sales in 1996 and around 3,000 in 1997.
Higher sales were due to the expansion of sales outlets for Renault cars and strong demand for the Renault Twingo, the spokesman said.
France Motors is planning to open several new sales outlets in Japan next year, the spokesman said.
